title: NGSH Ontology Registry
description: Machine-readable index of the NGSH ontology: entity types, relation types with allowed source/target types and cardinality, and the cross-type constraints that make the ontology a real model rather than a list of tables. Validated by tools/validate_contracts.py and consumed by the ontology service, the graph projector and the contract code generator.

ontologyVersion.description: Semantic version of the ontology. Breaking changes bump major.

pillars.description: Which pillars own or consume this type. Drives modular deployment and data-federation routing.

classificationFloor.description: Minimum handling level this type may ever carry. Prevents downgrade-by-construction.

pii.description: Contains personally identifiable information; drives retention and anonymisation rules.

mayCrossClassification.description: If false, an edge between differently-classified nodes is rejected at write time.

supportsRollup.description: Edge participates in confidence/verification roll-up along a trace path.

constraints.description: Cross-entity invariants enforced by the ontology service on write.
